name: Great Eagle Holdings Limited
summary: Great Eagle Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate business in Hong Kong, the United States, Mainland China, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, Italy, and internationally. The company operates through seven segments: Hotel Operation, Property Investment, Property Development, Other Operations, Champion REIT, Langham, and US Real Estate Fund. It offers hotel accommodation and management, as well as food and banquet operations; and invests in, owns, develops, manages, leases, and sells hotel, residential, office, retail, industrial, and mixed-use properties.
